'''Anders''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
Around [[3641 BBY]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Trey-yen]] and [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] Anders led a strike team on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] to place explosives in order to bring down an Imperial outpost from down below. When the [[Darth Baras]]' [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] interrupted the men, Anders asked to [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to let them go, but Trey-yen decided to detonate the explosives anyway in order to destroy themselves the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. However, the bomb failed to detonate and the [[Sith Warrior]] proceeded to kill Anders and the rest.
